project: VoiceGuard AI - Four-Block 2D CNN Spectrogram Classifier

model_architecture.block_1: Conv2d(1, 32, kernel_size=3, padding=1) -> BatchNorm2d(32) -> ReLU -> MaxPool2d(2, 2)
model_architecture.block_2: Conv2d(32, 64, kernel_size=3, padding=1) -> BatchNorm2d(64) -> ReLU -> MaxPool2d(2, 2)
model_architecture.block_3: Conv2d(64, 128, kernel_size=3, padding=1) -> BatchNorm2d(128) -> ReLU -> MaxPool2d(2, 2)
model_architecture.block_4: Conv2d(128, 256, kernel_size=3, padding=1) -> BatchNorm2d(256) -> ReLU -> AdaptiveAvgPool2d((8, None))
model_architecture.temporal_preservation: AdaptiveAvgPool2d preserves full time_frames axis (None) while standardizing frequency to 8 bins
model_architecture.sequence_encoder: LSTM(input_size=2048, hidden_size=128, num_layers=2, bidirectional=True, batch_first=True, dropout=0.35)
model_architecture.head: Dropout(0.35) -> Linear(256, 64) -> ReLU -> Dropout(0.175) -> Linear(64, 1)
model_architecture.output: Raw unconstrained scalar logit for BCEWithLogitsLoss

dataset_splits.splitting_policy: GroupKFold by parent_file and speaker_id (Zero recording/speaker leakage)
dataset_splits.train_split: data/splits/train_split_manifest.json (34 samples: 21 Real, 13 Fake across 10 parent recordings)
dataset_splits.validation_split: data/splits/val_manifest.json (6 samples: 3 Real, 3 Fake across 3 parent recordings)
dataset_splits.held_out_test_split: data/splits/test_manifest.json (13 samples: 6 Real, 7 Fake across 3 parent recordings - LOCKED)
dataset_splits.cross_dataset_split: data/splits/cross_dataset_manifest.json (2 samples: 0 Real, 2 Fake from zo9999 ElevenLabs)
